[[File:Hammer detail.png|left|120px]] A '''hammer''' is a tool used for smithing items on an [[Anvil]], and it is vital to level the [[Smithing]] skill. Hammers can be bought from most [[general store]]s and will never break. Alternatively, players can obtain a hammer by talking to the [[Master smithing tutor]] at the West [[Varrock]] anvil.  A hammer is also used in the [[Construction]] skill when making furniture, and it is required for some minigames.  At 15 Construction, members can make a [[Tool store 1]] for the workshop room of their house; this tool store provides an unlimited supply of hammers.

A hammer is required to access Bandos' stronghold in the [[God Wars Dungeon]]; warhammers are an acceptable substitute.

The [[Imcando hammer]] can be used instead of a hammer when performing tasks like [[Construction]] or [[Smithing]].
